/papers/deepcad/figure02_construction.pn.captionEnglish: Figure 2. A CAD model example specified by the commands in Table 1. (Top) the CAD model’s construction sequence, annotated with the command types. (Bottom) the command sequence description of the model. Parameter normalization and quantization are not shown in this case. In “Sketch 1”, L2-A3-L4-L5 forms a loop (in blue) and C7 forms another loop (in green), and the two loops bounds a sketch profile (in gray).
/papers/deepcad/figure02_construction.pn.captionChinese: 图2：使用表1中的命令定义的一个 CAD 模型示例。上部展示模型的构建顺序，并标注命令类型；下部给出模型的命令序列。本例未展示参数归一化和量化。在“草图1”中，L2–A3–L4–L5 构成一个蓝色的环，C7 构成另一个绿色的环，这两个环共同限定灰色的草图轮廓。
labelsChinese: Parametrized command sequence：参数化命令序列。
/papers/deepcad/figure02_construction.pn.translatorNote: 原图注写 C7，而图内圆命令标记为 R7；译文分别保留这两个符号。

/papers/deepcad/table01_commands.png.captionEnglish: Table 1. CAD commands and their parameters. ⟨SOL⟩indicates the start of a loop; ⟨EOS⟩indicates the end of the whole sequence.
/papers/deepcad/table01_commands.png.captionChinese: 表1：CAD 命令及其参数。〈SOL〉表示一个环的开始；〈EOS〉表示整个序列的结束。

/papers/deepcad/figure03_architecture.pn.captionEnglish: Figure 3. Our network architecture. The input CAD model, represented as a command sequence M = {C_i}_{i=1}^{N_c} is first projected to an embedding space and then fed to the encoder E resulting in a latent vector z. The decoder D takes learned constant embeddings as input, and also attends to the latent vector z. It then outputs the predicted command sequence M-hat = {C-hat_i}_{i=1}^{N_c}.
/papers/deepcad/figure03_architecture.pn.captionChinese: 图3：我们的网络结构。输入 CAD 模型表示为包含 Nc 条命令的序列 M={Ci}（i=1,…,Nc），首先投影到嵌入空间，再输入编码器 E，得到潜向量 z。解码器 D 以学习得到的常量嵌入为输入，同时关注潜向量 z，随后输出预测的命令序列。
labelsChinese: Learned Constant Embeddings：学习得到的常量嵌入，是解码器的输入。

/papers/deepcad/table02_autoencoding.png.captionEnglish: Table 2. Quantitative evaluation of autoencoding. ACCcmd and ACCparam are both multiplied by 100%, and CD is multiplied by 10³. ↑: a higher metric value indicates better autoencoding quality. ↓: a lower metric value is better. ACC values for Alt-Regr are not available since Alt-Regr does not use quantized parameters.
/papers/deepcad/table02_autoencoding.png.captionChinese: 表2：自编码的定量评价。ACCcmd 和 ACCparam 以百分比报告，CD 的显示值乘以10³。↑表示数值越大，自编码质量越好；↓表示数值越小越好。Alt-Regr 不使用量化参数，因此没有对应的 ACC 数值。
labelsChinese: ACCcmd／ACCparam：命令／参数准确率；Invalid Ratio：无效比例。

/papers/deepcad/figure04_comparison.png.captionEnglish: Figure 4. Comparison of autoencoding results. Hidden edges are also rendered visible (white). Ground truth (GT) is shown in the bottom row. Our best results are highlighted in the dash-line box.
/papers/deepcad/figure04_comparison.png.captionChinese: 图4：自编码结果比较。隐藏边也被渲染为可见的白色线条。最下方一行为真实模型（GT）；本文方法的最佳结果用虚线框突出显示。
labelsChinese: Ours+Aug：加入数据增强的本文方法。

/papers/deepcad/table03_generation.png.captionEnglish: Table 3. Shape generation measured under point-cloud metrics. We use the metrics in l-GAN [6]. Both MMD and JSD are multiplied by 10². ↑: the higher the better, ↓: the lower the better.
/papers/deepcad/table03_generation.png.captionChinese: 表3：在点云指标下衡量形状生成质量。使用 l-GAN 文献[6]中的指标。MMD 和 JSD 的显示值均乘以10²。↑表示越大越好，↓表示越小越好。
labelsChinese: COV：覆盖率；其余指标的含义见下文。

/papers/deepcad/figure06_pointcloud.png.captionEnglish: Figure 6. CAD model reconstruction from point clouds. (Top) input point clouds. (Bottom) reconstructed CAD models.
/papers/deepcad/figure06_pointcloud.png.captionChinese: 图6：从点云重建 CAD 模型。上方为输入点云，下方为重建的 CAD 模型。

/papers/deepcad/table06_pointcloud.png.captionEnglish: Table 6. Quantitative results for CAD reconstruction from point clouds. Ours-noise corresponds to noisy inputs (uniform noise in [−0.02, 0.02] along normal direction). We use the same metrics as in autoencoding task; ACCcmd and ACCparam are both multiplied by 100%, and CD is multiplied by 10³.
/papers/deepcad/table06_pointcloud.png.captionChinese: 表6：从点云重建 CAD 的定量结果。Ours-noise 对应带噪声的输入，即沿法向加入范围为[−0.02, 0.02]的均匀噪声。采用与自编码任务相同的指标；ACCcmd 和 ACCparam 以百分比报告，CD 的显示值乘以10³。
labelsChinese: Ours-noise：带噪声输入下的本文方法；Invalid Ratio：无效比例。

labelsChinese: Move face：移动面；Fillet：圆角。

/papers/deepcad/figure11_failures.png.captionEnglish: Figure 11. Failure examples in shape autoencoding. Top: our reconstructed CAD outputs. Bottom: ground-truth CAD models.

/papers/deepcad/figure12_length.png.captionEnglish: Figure 12. Quantitative metrics for shape autoencoding w.r.t. CAD sequence length. Left: median chamfer distance (the lower the better). Right: parameter accuracy (the higher the better).
/papers/deepcad/figure12_length.png.captionChinese: 图12：形状自编码定量指标随 CAD 序列长度的变化。左图为倒角距离中位数，越低越好；右图为参数准确率，越高越好。
labelsChinese: 横轴为序列长度；Med CD 为 CD 中位数，Param ACC 为参数准确率。

/papers/text2cad/figure04_prompt_levels..captionEnglish: Figure 4: Parametric CAD model generation by Text2CAD transformer using different text prompts. Our text prompts follow a certain structure highlighting the different design aspects of CAD construction workflow (shown in different colors).
/papers/text2cad/figure04_prompt_levels..captionChinese: 图4：Text2CAD Transformer 使用不同文本提示生成参数化 CAD 模型。文本提示遵循一定结构，强调 CAD 构建流程中不同的设计要素，并以不同颜色区分。
labelsChinese: L0–L3：抽象级、初学者级、中等级、专家级；逐级增加描述细节。

/papers/text2cad/figure02_annotation.png.captionEnglish: Figure 2: Text2CAD Data Annotation Pipeline: Our data annotation pipeline generates multi-level text prompts describing the construction workflow of a CAD model with varying complexities. We use a two-stage method - (Stage 1) Shape description generation using VLM (Stage 2) Multi-Level textual annotation generation using LLM.
/papers/text2cad/figure02_annotation.png.captionChinese: 图2：Text2CAD 数据标注流水线。该流程生成不同复杂程度的多层次文本提示，用于描述 CAD 模型的构建过程。采用两个阶段：第一阶段使用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成形状描述；第二阶段使用大语言模型（LLM）生成多层次文本标注。
labelsChinese: Minimal Metadata Generator：最小元数据生成器；NLI：自然语言指令。

/papers/text2cad/figure03_network.png.captionEnglish: Figure 3: Network architecture: Text2CAD Transformer takes as input a text prompt T and a CAD subsequence C1:t−1 of length t−1. The text embedding Tadapt is extracted from T using a pretrained BeRT Encoder ([7]) followed by a trainable Adaptive layer. The resulting embedding Tadapt and the CAD sequence embedding F0t−1 is passed through L decoder blocks to generate the full CAD sequence in auto-regressive way.
/papers/text2cad/figure03_network.png.captionChinese: 图3：网络结构。Text2CAD Transformer 的输入为文本提示 T 和长度为 t−1 的 CAD 子序列 C1:t−1。使用预训练 BeRT 编码器[7]及其后的可训练自适应层，从 T 中提取文本嵌入 Tadapt。该嵌入与 CAD 序列嵌入 F⁰t−1 一起经过 L 个解码器模块，以自回归方式生成完整 CAD 序列。
labelsChinese: Cross-Attention：交叉注意力；Trainable／Frozen：可训练／冻结参数。

/papers/text2cad/table01_expert.png.captionEnglish: Table 1: Quantitative evaluation between DeepCAD [55] and our method (AL is Adaptive Layer). The scores are evaluated only for Expert Level (L3) prompts. The results include F1 scores for primitives and extrusions as well as mean and median CD and IR. CD is multiplied by 10³.
/papers/text2cad/table01_expert.png.captionChinese: 表1：DeepCAD[55]与本文方法的定量比较，AL 表示自适应层。只使用专家级（L3）提示计算分数。结果包括几何基元和拉伸的 F1 分数，以及 CD 的均值、中位数和 IR。CD 的显示值乘以10³。
labelsChinese: IR：无效比例；w/o AL：去掉自适应层。

/papers/text2cad/table02_preferences.png.captionEnglish: Table 2: We conduct GPT-4 evaluation of the CAD models generated from 1000 prompts per level and User studies of 100 samples per level. In both evaluations, overall Text2CAD is a favored choice over DeepCAD.
/papers/text2cad/table02_preferences.png.captionChinese: 表2：每个提示层级使用1000条提示所生成的 CAD 模型进行 GPT-4 评价，并对每个层级的100个样本开展用户研究。在两类评价中，总体上 Text2CAD 比 DeepCAD 更受偏好。
labelsChinese: Undecided：未作出选择。

/papers/text2cad/figure09_failures.png.captionEnglish: Figure 9: Failure cases for Text2CAD Transformer. Invalid Samples (left): The network fails to generate any valid CAD model. Discrepancy Cases (right): The generated CAD model does not match the input text prompts.
/papers/text2cad/figure09_failures.png.captionChinese: 图9：Text2CAD Transformer 的失败案例。左侧的无效样本中，网络未能生成任何有效的 CAD 模型；右侧的不一致案例中，生成的 CAD 模型与输入文本提示不符。
labelsChinese: Invalidity：无效模型；Discrepancy：生成结果与文本不一致。

/papers/cad-llama/figure02_overview.png.captionEnglish: Figure 2. Overview of the proposed framework CAD-Llama. The framework consists of two parts: (1) SPCC data synthesis, which employs the hierarchical annotation pipeline to convert CAD sequences into SPCC representations, and (2) the pretraining and instruction tuning process, where the resulting SPCC corpus is leveraged to enhance model performance.
/papers/cad-llama/figure02_overview.png.captionChinese: 图2：所提出的 CAD-Llama 框架概览。框架包括两部分：第一部分是 SPCC 数据合成，利用层次标注流水线将 CAD 序列转换为 SPCC 表示；第二部分是预训练与指令微调，利用所得 SPCC 语料提升模型性能。
labelsChinese: SPCC Adaptive Pretraining：SPCC 适配预训练；CAD-Centric Instruction Tuning：面向 CAD 的指令微调。

/papers/cad-llama/figure03_annotation.pn.captionEnglish: Figure 3. Hierarchical Annotation Pipeline. The figure illustrates our two-stage annotation process for CAD models. In the first stage, detailed descriptions of individual components are generated. In the second stage, a global description is produced, which includes both an abstract overview and detailed descriptions that capture the spatial relationships between components.
/papers/cad-llama/figure03_annotation.pn.captionChinese: 图3：层次标注流水线。图中展示 CAD 模型的两阶段标注过程：第一阶段生成各部件的详细描述；第二阶段生成全局描述，同时包含抽象概述，以及能够表达部件间空间关系的详细描述。
labelsChinese: Components Desc／Overall Desc：部件描述／整体描述。

/papers/cad-llama/table07_cost.png.captionEnglish: Table 7. Training costs and token consumption during the two training stages. Tokens are used for prompt generation in each stage.
/papers/cad-llama/table07_cost.png.captionChinese: 表7：两个训练阶段的训练成本与 token 消耗。表中的 token 用于各阶段的提示生成。
labelsChinese: A100-GPU Hours：A100 GPU 小时数；Tokens (GPT-4o)：GPT-4o token 数。

/papers/cad-llama/table04_text.png.captionEnglish: Table 4. Results on text-to-CAD task. The metric ACCT is multiplied by 100%. MCD, MMD, and JSD are multiplied by 10².
/papers/cad-llama/table04_text.png.captionChinese: 表4：文本到 CAD 任务的结果。ACCT 以百分比报告；MCD、MMD、JSD 的显示值乘以10²。
labelsChinese: ↑ 越大越好；↓ 越小越好。

/papers/cad-llama/table06_representation.captionEnglish: Table 6. Evaluation of different CAD representation methods in the Text-to-CAD task. SDCS uses a single textual description as a prefix along with CAD command sequences, while SDCC uses CAD code with a single description. SPCS incorporates hierarchical descriptions with CAD command sequences, and SPCC combines hierarchical descriptions with CAD code.
/papers/cad-llama/table06_representation.captionChinese: 表6：文本到 CAD 任务中不同 CAD 表示方法的评价。SDCS 使用单个文本描述作为 CAD 命令序列的前缀；SDCC 使用单个描述配合 CAD 代码；SPCS 将层次描述与 CAD 命令序列结合；SPCC 则将层次描述与 CAD 代码结合。
labelsChinese: ACCcmd／ACCparam：命令／参数准确率；SR：成功率。

/papers/cad-llama/figure25_failures.png.captionEnglish: Figure 25. Failure cases for CAD-Llama-INS. We illustrate two types of errors: inaccuracies in parameter settings and misalignment with the text prompts.
/papers/cad-llama/figure25_failures.png.captionChinese: 图25：CAD-Llama-INS 的失败案例。这里展示两类错误：参数设置不准确，以及与文本提示不匹配。
labelsChinese: Parameter Error：参数错误；Mismatch Text Description：与文本描述不符。

/papers/cad-recode/figure02_representati.captionEnglish: Figure 2. Sketch-extrude sequence (top) in DeepCAD representation (middle) and our CadQuery code (bottom).
/papers/cad-recode/figure02_representati.captionChinese: 图2：草图—拉伸序列位于上方；其中间形式为 DeepCAD 表示，下方为本文的 CadQuery 代码。
labelsChinese: Sketch-Extrude sequence：草图—拉伸序列；Our CadQuery representation：本文的 CadQuery 表示。

/papers/cad-recode/figure04_network.png.captionEnglish: Figure 4. Overview of CAD-Recode. The pipeline comprises two parts: (1) a point cloud projector (marked blue) (2) a fine-tuned pretrained LLM (yellow). An input point cloud is processed using (1), and outputs are then passed to an LLM (2), which predicts a CAD sketch-extrude sequence in the form of executable Python code.
/papers/cad-recode/figure04_network.png.captionChinese: 图4：CAD-Recode 概览。流程包括两部分：蓝色部分是点云投影器，黄色部分是经过微调的预训练大语言模型。输入点云先由点云投影器处理，所得输出再传给语言模型，由其以可执行 Python 代码的形式预测 CAD 草图—拉伸序列。
labelsChinese: Python interpreter：Python 解释器，负责执行生成代码。

/papers/cad-recode/table01_reconstructio.captionEnglish: Table 1. Comparison of CAD reverse engineering methods on DeepCAD and Fusion360 datasets. Our CAD-Recode trained on the 160 k DeepCAD dataset demonstrates an improvement over existing state-of-the-art methods both in terms of geometric fidelity and validity of the generated sketch-extrude sequences. Our procedurally generated dataset provides a significant boost in the prediction quality.
/papers/cad-recode/table01_reconstructio.captionChinese: 表1：在 DeepCAD 与 Fusion360 数据集上比较 CAD 逆向工程方法。使用16万条 DeepCAD 数据训练的 CAD-Recode，在生成草图—拉伸序列的几何保真度和有效性上优于现有先进方法。本文程序化生成的数据集进一步显著提升预测质量。
labelsChinese: Mean／Med. CD：CD 均值／中位数；IR：无效比例。

/papers/cad-recode/table02_scans.png.captionEnglish: Table 2. Results on the CC3D dataset, where input point clouds are sampled from real 3D scans. CAD-Recode significantly outperforms DeepCAD, and CAD-SIGNet.
/papers/cad-recode/table02_scans.png.captionChinese: 表2：CC3D 数据集上的结果，其输入点云采样自真实三维扫描。CAD-Recode 显著优于 DeepCAD 和 CAD-SIGNet。
labelsChinese: IoU：交并比；IR：无效比例。

/papers/cad-recode/table03_sampling.png.captionEnglish: Table 3. Ablation of training data and test-time sampling. The results demonstrate the advantage of training on our procedurally generated data, while the test-time sampling helps reducing the invalidity ratio. CD stands for mean Chamfer distance.
/papers/cad-recode/table03_sampling.png.captionChinese: 表3：训练数据和测试时采样的消融。结果展示了程序化生成训练数据的优势，测试时采样则有助于降低无效比例。CD 指平均倒角距离。
labelsChinese: Test-time Sampling：测试时采样；✓／✗：采用／不采用。

/papers/cad-recode/figure06_editing.png.captionChinese: 图6：CAD 模型的交互式编辑。给定 CAD-Recode 输出的代码和一个通用提示，可以利用 GPT-4o 对 CAD 模型进行自动化、交互式编辑。
labelsChinese: User Prompt：用户提示；Executed Code：执行的代码；User Edit：用户编辑。

/papers/cad-mllm/figure02_dataset.png.captionEnglish: Fig. 2: Qualitative comparison between our CAD command sequence dataset and DeepCAD [1] dataset. According to Sec. 4, DeepCAD dataset is part of our created dataset. In the visualization of our dataset, we exclude the CAD models’ IDs that have been included in the DeepCAD dataset. The extension part of our dataset contains more complex and realistic models with more details. Best viewed zoomed in.
/papers/cad-mllm/figure02_dataset.png.captionChinese: 图2：本文 CAD 命令序列数据集与 DeepCAD[1]数据集的定性比较。如第4节所述，DeepCAD 是本文所建数据集的一部分。展示本文数据集时，排除了已经收录在 DeepCAD 中的模型 ID。扩展部分包含更复杂、更接近真实、细节更多的模型。建议放大查看。

/papers/cad-mllm/figure04_network.png.captionEnglish: Fig. 4: Our network architecture. The network could process three single modalities of information of input or any combinations of them, each uniquely color-coded. We consider the most complex combination of modalities, where three different inputs are provided simultaneously. Except for the textual descriptions, each modality is first processed through its corresponding frozen encoder before being further integrated. Subsequently, they are passed through a trainable projection layer, aligning them within a unified language feature space. The fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs), augmented with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), then process a combination of the prompt and the projected embeddings, enabling the accurate generation of CAD models.
/papers/cad-mllm/figure04_network.png.captionChinese: 图4：网络结构。网络能够处理三种单独的输入模态，或它们的任意组合；不同模态用不同颜色表示。图中展示最复杂的组合，即同时提供三种输入。除文本描述外，每种模态首先经过各自的冻结编码器，再进一步整合；随后通过可训练投影层，对齐到统一的语言特征空间。加入低秩适配（LoRA）的微调语言模型处理提示与投影后嵌入的组合，从而准确生成 CAD 模型。
labelsChinese: Multi-view Images／Textual Description／Point Cloud：多视图图像／文本描述／点云。

/papers/cad-mllm/table03_points.png.captionEnglish: TABLE 3: The quantitative results on point-based reconstruction tasks. Our method’s performance is comparable to some “B-rep”-based reconstruction methods in “point cloud”-based reconstruction metrics (Chamfer, F-score, Normal C). However, it significantly outperforms these methods in our proposed topological metrics (SegE, DangEL, and SIR) and the enclosure metric (FluxEE). Moreover, our method consistently surpasses the command sequence-based generation baseline across all evaluated metrics.
/papers/cad-mllm/table03_points.png.captionChinese: 表3：基于点云的重建任务的定量结果。在基于点云的重建指标（Chamfer、F-score、Normal C）上，本文方法与部分基于 B-rep 的重建方法相当；但在本文提出的拓扑指标（SegE、DangEL、SIR）和闭合性指标（FluxEE）上显著优于这些方法。此外，本文方法在全部评价指标上均优于基于命令序列的生成基线。
labelsChinese: Normal C：法向一致性；×100 表示显示值乘以100。

/papers/cad-mllm/table05_text.png.captionEnglish: TABLE 5: The user study results on text-conditioned generation tasks. We evaluate the generated models based on two criteria: text alignment and model quality. A higher score indicates better performance, with both criteria rated on a 5-point scale.
/papers/cad-mllm/table05_text.png.captionChinese: 表5：文本条件生成任务的用户研究结果。从文本对齐和模型质量两个方面评价生成模型。两项均采用五分制，分数越高越好。
labelsChinese: Text Alignment：文本对齐；Model Quality：模型质量。

/papers/cad-mllm/table07_multimodal.png.captionEnglish: TABLE 7: The quantitative study on training with multimodal data. (a) Our multimodal model outperforms the image-only model across all reconstruction, topology, and enclosure metrics. (b) Our multimodal model is comparable with the pointonly model in terms of topology and enclosure metrics. However, the point reconstruction performance of our multimodal model is slightly weaker than the point-only model.
/papers/cad-mllm/table07_multimodal.png.captionChinese: 表7：使用多模态数据训练的定量研究。(a) 多模态模型在全部重建、拓扑和闭合性指标上优于仅图像模型。(b) 在拓扑和闭合性指标上，多模态模型与仅点云模型相当；但其点云重建性能略弱于仅点云模型。
labelsChinese: Ours(Image)／Ours(Point)／Ours(Multimodal)：仅图像／仅点云／多模态版本。

/papers/cad-mllm/figure14_failures.png.captionEnglish: Fig. 14: We present the failure case of our method on some challenging cases, such as thin structures and complicated details. Dangling edges exist in these failure results.
/papers/cad-mllm/figure14_failures.png.captionChinese: 图14：本文方法在薄结构、复杂细节等具有挑战性的情形下的失败案例。这些失败结果中存在悬空边。

/papers/cadreview/figure02_dataset.png.captionEnglish: Figure 2: Construction workflow of our CADReview dataset, including program-drawing pairs collection, error creation and feedback annotation.
/papers/cadreview/figure02_dataset.png.captionChinese: 图2：CADReview 数据集的构建流程，包括收集程序—图像对、创建错误，以及标注反馈。

/papers/cadreview/figure03_errors.png.captionChinese: 图3：CADReview 数据集中八类 CAD 程序错误的示例。第一行为从一个采样视角观察到的参考图像；第二行展示对 CAD 程序创建错误时修改的代码片段；最后一行为错误程序渲染出的三维物体。
labelsChinese: Primitive／Rotation／Position／Size：基元／旋转／位置／尺寸；Logic／Missing／Redundant：逻辑／缺失／冗余。

/papers/cadreview/figure06_correction.pn.captionEnglish: Figure 6: Cases of different methods. The green and red denote correct and incorrect prediction, respectively.
/papers/cadreview/figure06_correction.pn.captionChinese: 图6：不同方法的案例。绿色表示预测正确，红色表示预测错误。

/papers/cadtests/figure01_motivation.png.captionEnglish: Figure 1: CADTESTS are executable programs that verify prompt specifications directly on the generated geometry. CADTESTS can account for ambiguous design prompts (left) and identify subtle structural errors (right). The figure ommits CADTEST implementations for clarity.
/papers/cadtests/figure01_motivation.png.captionChinese: 图1：CADTESTS 是直接在生成几何上验证提示规格的可执行程序。它们能够处理含糊的设计提示（左），并识别细微的结构错误（右）。为便于展示，图中省略了 CADTESTS 的实现。
labelsChinese: Chamfer Distance：倒角距离；Passed All Tests：全部测试通过。

/papers/cadtests/figure02_pipeline.png.captionEnglish: Figure 2: Illustration of the proposed CADTest synthesis pipeline. (Top) A design prompt and reference CAD program are provided to an LLM planner to generate CAD mutants. (Bottom) The planner generates a test suite that is iteratively refined using execution feedback from the passing and mutation sets. In this example, a mutation that is not killed in R = 1 is detected in R = N after adding a test comparing the volumes of the inner and outer cylindrical faces.
/papers/cadtests/figure02_pipeline.png.captionChinese: 图2：所提出的 CADTest 合成流水线。上部将设计提示与参考 CAD 程序提供给 LLM 规划器，以生成 CAD 变异体；下部由规划器生成测试套件，并根据正确样本集合与变异集合上的执行反馈迭代改进。本例中，第1轮未被检出的变异，在第 N 轮加入比较内外圆柱面“体积”的测试后被检出。
labelsChinese: Mutation Generation：变异生成；Passing Set／Mutation Set：正确样本集合／变异集合。
/papers/cadtests/figure02_pipeline.png.translatorNote: 原图注使用 volumes（体积），图内新增测试文字使用 face area（面面积）；译文按原图分别保留，二者不能混作同一几何量。

/papers/cadtests/table01_test_generation.captionEnglish: Table 1: CADTESTS generation performance for abstract prompts in terms of validity, soundness, and mutation score. We evaluate various LLM planners and compare two prompting strategies: providing the planner with 20 CAD test demonstrations in its context, or supplying a skill file that disambiguated how tests should be written. The table presents both percentages and total counts.
/papers/cadtests/table01_test_generation.captionChinese: 表1：针对抽象提示，以有效性、健全性和变异分数评价 CADTESTS 的生成性能。比较不同 LLM 规划器，以及两种提示策略：在上下文中提供20个 CAD 测试示例，或提供说明测试编写方式的技能文件。表中同时给出百分比和总计数。
labelsChinese: Valid：有效测试比例；Sound：健全测试比例；MScore：变异分数。

/papers/cadtests/table02_refinement.png.captionEnglish: Table 2: Effectiveness of the refinement loop. Scores are reported for the reference implementation, CAD mutants, as well as their augmented variants.
/papers/cadtests/table02_refinement.png.captionChinese: 表2：迭代改进闭环的有效性。分别对参考实现、CAD 变异体及其增强版本报告分数。
labelsChinese: SoundAugm／MScoreAugm：增强版本的健全性／变异分数。

/papers/cadtests/table03_generation.png.captionEnglish: Table 3: Evaluation of Text-to-CAD methods on CADTESTBENCH. Results are reported for both the abstract and detailed partitions. Text-to-CAD baselines are evaluated using different LLM planners. Performance is measured in terms of pass rate, requirement score, and invalidity rate.
/papers/cadtests/table03_generation.png.captionChinese: 表3：在 CADTESTBENCH 上评价文本到 CAD 方法，分别报告抽象与详细两个子集的结果。文本到 CAD 基线使用不同的 LLM 规划器，以通过率、要求得分和无效比例衡量性能。
labelsChinese: IR：无效比例；RS：要求得分；PR：通过率。

/papers/cadtests/table04_human.png.captionEnglish: Table 4: Agreement with human consensus annotations (Cohen’s κ=0.54). Left: Pass-rate agreement for CADTESTS and the LLM-based metric of [38]. Right: AUC for continuous score metrics against the binary human label.
/papers/cadtests/table04_human.png.captionChinese: 表4：与人工共识标注的一致性，Cohen 的 κ=0.54。左侧比较 CADTESTS 与文献[38]中基于 LLM 的指标在通过率判定上的一致性；右侧以二元人工标签为依据，报告连续评分指标的 AUC。
labelsChinese: Precision／Recall：精确率／召回率；AUC：曲线下面积。

/papers/cadtests/figure04_examples.png.captionEnglish: Figure 4: Example generations from the CADTest-Claude baseline evaluated via CADTESTS. Green indicates passed tests and red indicates failed tests. For clarity, only a subset of test descriptions is shown and full test implementations are omitted.
/papers/cadtests/figure04_examples.png.captionChinese: 图4：由 CADTest-Claude 基线生成、并使用 CADTESTS 评价的示例。绿色表示测试通过，红色表示测试失败。为便于阅读，图中仅展示部分测试描述，省略完整测试实现。
labelsChinese: Failure：测试未通过的原因；左图星尖角间距近似均匀，右图圆柱面数量与要求不符。

/papers/cad-editor/figure03_dataset.png.captionEnglish: Figure 3. Illustration of automated data synthesis pipeline.
/papers/cad-editor/figure03_dataset.png.captionChinese: 图3：自动数据合成流水线示意。
labelsChinese: Design Variation Generation：设计变体生成；Stepwise Captioning：逐步描述。

/papers/cad-editor/figure04_network.png.captionEnglish: Figure 4. (a)-(b): Overview of Locate-then-Infill framework. (c): Examples of input and output, where the left column shows abstracted representations using legends, the middle column displays concrete sequences and the right column presents rendered visual objects.
/papers/cad-editor/figure04_network.png.captionChinese: 图4：(a)–(b)为先定位、后补全（Locate-then-Infill）框架的概览。(c)为输入与输出示例：左列以图例抽象表示，中列给出具体序列，右列展示渲染后的可视物体。

JSD, CD, and D-CLIP values are scaled by 10². ↑: the higher the better, ↓: the lower the better.

/papers/cad-editor/figure10_iterative.pn.captionChinese: 图10：反复应用 CAD-Editor 编辑一个 CAD 模型，直至满足用户要求。

/papers/cad-assistant/figure02_loop.png.captionEnglish: Figure 2. Overview of CAD-Assistant framework. A multimodal user request is provided as context to a VLLM planner P. At step t, the planner generates a plan pt and an action at (python code). The action is executed on an environment E and the generated execution output ft is fed back to the planner, enabling generation for the next timestep.
/papers/cad-assistant/figure02_loop.png.captionChinese: 图2：CAD-Assistant 框架概览。将多模态用户请求作为上下文提供给 VLLM 规划器 P。在时间步 t，规划器生成计划 pt 与动作 at（Python 代码）。动作在环境 E 中执行，产生的执行输出 ft 被反馈给规划器，用于生成下一个时间步的内容。
labelsChinese: Planner／ToolSet／Environment：规划器／工具集／环境；Plan／Action：自然语言计划／Python 动作。
Constraint Checker：约束检查工具；Crosssection Extract：截面提取工具。

/papers/cad-assistant/table11_cost.png.captionEnglish: Table 11. Cost per user request for the CAD-Assistant utilizing GPT-4o as VLLM planner.
/papers/cad-assistant/table11_cost.png.captionChinese: 表11：使用 GPT-4o 作为 VLLM 规划器时，CAD-Assistant 每个用户请求的成本。
labelsChinese: Avg Cost per User Request：每个用户请求的平均成本，金额单位为美元。
